reviews.comment: I LOVE Tarone. He's such a cool and quirky guy, and lectures were surprisingly fun, and I HATE bugs. The lab took so much time and was actually kinda stressful, and don't even get me started on the deposition at the end of the semester. However, the class itself was a breeze, exams were easy and there was only a few assignments, all easy!

Lectures can be a bit confusing on what you need to know for the quizzes and exams, but you get a page of notes, front and back for the exams. Graded by 2 quizzes, 2 exams (exam 2 optional), 2 article review papers, 1 TOC worksheet, and 1 zombie short story paper. Dr. Tarone is a knowledgable Entomologist and can provide insight into the field.

Dr. Tarone is a great prof, his lectures are super engaging and interesting. The exams and quizzes were straight from the powerpoint, so as long as you study those you should be fine. Also lots of opportunities for extra credit.
He was nice but so unorganized, often made instructions unclear on his assignments. Not a tough grader, so there's your silver lining.

This class is pretty interesting stuff but Tarone didn't really explain what he expected from his 2 exams and 3 papers. There's so much outside work and he kind of expects you to already be an expert on forensics and ento. When I asked questions, he would always reply with sass. I'm kinda disappointed I didn't enjoy this class more
reviews.ratingTags: SO MANY PAPERS--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS
